aggregation: all 4 complete seeds, equal path counts; pooled unbiased sample variance and seed t95 diagnostics separately
exclude_from_targets: resource/worker/solver failures and pending stay censored, never become inaccuracy labels
fallback: separate accuracy surrogates: Remizov point success, MC per-seed observed success probability with 4 repeated targets and grouped split; experimental aggregate error regression
features: ml.remizov_features input-only whitelist; 253 inputs; scaler train only
minimum_comparative_labels: at least 100 train rows,40 train families,30 per class in train; at least10 per class in validation/test. Otherwise no comparative classifier
no_runtime_winner: MC x0 time and historical Remizov33 time are separate incomparable timing columns
numerical_policy: fixed frozen MC plan; exact metrics computed only after solve
selection: validation logloss for accuracy; validation MAE log10 error for regression. Test only after models frozen
split: original 700/150/150 and 140/30/30 families; never split seed replicas across subsets
uncertainty: family bootstrap 500 resamples on held-out families; 4 seeds cannot prove p(success)>=.95
winner: exploratory label for discrete-truncated expectation: t95 seed-mean CI plus certified tail, error interval relative to exact separated from saved Remizov error by .0025; else uncertain; time bias not removed
